digest.component_or_area: review-kernel cutover guard and cross-gate integration
propositions: A deterministic shadow comparator must consume the same call/result set as legacy and RP-06 projections and report field-level mismatches, accepting only approved deltas (effective retune/disable, project DET inclusion, project LLM applicability, code-review budget enforcement, typed partial-failure continuation, success-only checkpointing).

Repository policy guards must fail when a review gate reads packaged/project routing directly instead of via CriteriaSnapshot, when a second discovery scheduler is introduced outside the shared kernel, or when per-unit trace fields enter review/review-status schemas.

Cross-gate fixture paths exercised through the real external LLM provider matrix must produce approved final dispositions, prove at least one discovery call reaches the configured provider, and assert narrow verdict plus internal trace retention without printing secrets or prompt bodies.

Public response schemas for review-plan, review-plan --status, and code-review must remain narrow while their reducer-ignored journals retain versioned internal traces and new code ignores legacy checkpoint envelopes.

A live canary at tests/external/test_review_discovery_live.py confined to external and llm_live markers must drive the real default discovery path and assert PASS/BLOCK verdict with coverage.llm_ran true and sidecar_emitted true, printing no secrets or trace.

Ownership, approved deltas, sensitive-data boundary, shadow behavior, and revert-based rollback must be documented in docs/review-kernel.md with snapshot/executor/gate/RP-01 ownership and code revert as the rollback mechanism.
